title: Gather candidates + filter by explicit criteria
trigger: A single query shape returns the wrong candidate because assumptions about the result set are fragile
principle: Don't assume a single query result matches intent. Gather candidates from several query shapes, then filter by explicit criteria to pick the correct one.

cases.context: Active-tab query returns an app-window tab (chrome-extension:// URL) instead of the content tab on Edge
lastFocusedWindow fallback returns null on Edge, so it cannot rescue the primary query

applyFor: chrome.tabs.query where a single shape is fragile (Edge app-windows, multiple windows)
Database queries with complex WHERE (gather rows from several queries, filter by criteria)
API responses with mixed data types (gather all, filter by type field)
Any lookup where the assumed result-set shape breaks on a platform or edge case
